Geographies Served Programs Anubhav - Transforming School Education State Maharashtra States Maharashtra Anubhav is a flagship program of the Nikalas Foundation. It represents 'Anubhavatmak Shiksha' or 'Experiential Learning'. The programme makes use of specially created kits that are exactly aligned with the science and math curriculum for each grade. The kits are an effective teaching and learning tool that significantly raises the learning objectives of each class period. The inception of 'Anubhav' commences with an extensive training programme for educators on experiential learning methodology, succeeded by the integration of kits into the regular teaching and learning process. An evaluation of the program's impact concludes it. Throughout the implementation, Team Nikalas Foundation is accessible to provide prompt query resolution. Aside from the academics, we assume responsibility for the complete overhaul of the schools in these initiatives.
